# GEOMETRY

> Deterministic temporal semantic layer for AI builders — birth cards, calendars, moon phases, seasons, retrogrades, and ~30 systems on a 1900–2100 date spine.

## Canonical MCP URL

https://mcp.geometry.app/mcp

Use this URL only in install instructions. Do not teach `*.zuplo.app` hosts.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.geometry.app/introduction): What GEOMETRY is
- [Quickstart](https://docs.geometry.app/quickstart): Claude / Cursor connector paste
- [Connect & manage your key](https://docs.geometry.app/connect-and-keys): `?key=` URL form, Zuplo roll, cancel
- [Why deterministic](https://docs.geometry.app/why-deterministic): Same call → same JSON
- [Tools overview](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/overview): Tool catalog
- [get_card_for_birthdate](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-card-for-birthdate): Tool 2 — full sample JSON for 1985-03-15
- [get_compatibility](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-compatibility): Tool 1 — two birth dates
- [get_day_card](https://docs.geometry.app/tools/get-day-card): Tool 3 — day card + day ruler
- [Data coverage](https://docs.geometry.app/coverage): Systems on the date spine
- [Field glossary](https://docs.geometry.app/field-glossary): What `_no` fields mean — tradition vs internal catalog numbers, `0`/`none` sentinels
- [FAQ](https://docs.geometry.app/faq): Common questions
- [Support](https://docs.geometry.app/support): GitHub Issues — only public builder contact

## Support

Builders: https://docs.geometry.app/support → GitHub Issues on geometry-mcp. No public product email.
Urgent key revoke: issue title `[urgent] key revoke` (never paste the key).

## Rules for agents

- All string fields lowercase except glyph fields (e.g. `unicard_symbol`).
- Missing scalars use sentinels — `0` numeric, `none` text, `""` symbol, `[]` list — not `null`. Known exception: `day_ruler.norse.deity` is `null` on Saturdays (laugardagr has no deity). `_no` fields are non-negative.
- `_no` fields are internal catalog ids for tracing/support — not a public contract. Key on names and slugs. Exceptions carrying real tradition meaning: `card_no`, `tarot_no`, `iching_no`, `atomic_no`, `chakra_no`, `house_no`, `pada_no`.
- Published full window: 1900-01-01 … 2100-12-31 (`temporal_context: "full"`).
- GEOMETRY returns structured reference data; interpretation is the host app / model.
- Site: https://geometry.app · Company: https://goqo.com
- Builder support: GitHub Issues on https://github.com/goqolabs/geometry-mcp (not company spam inboxes)
